notes.title: Update Notes September 18th, 2024
notes.notes:
Added melee weapon, the sword!
Added better support for controllers for scroll menu. Slowly moving toward steam deck verification.
Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Update Notes for July 28th, 2024
notes.notes:
Characters now have googly eyes.
Added electric bullet drops that apply to the players guns for 30 seconds.
New shipping container character.

New music coming soon!

notes.title: Regular Update #3
notes.notes:
Literally Blow your enemies away with the new leaf-blower!

Enjoy 5 new achievements and refined player movement.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KTsPlAs.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes, July 10th
notes.notes:
•Refined pacing of enemy spawns
•Fixed an issue with pick-up range upgrades being ridiculous too early

notes.title: Update Notes for July 8th
notes.notes:
•I've added some balloons that spawn in grasslands and if you don't pop em they'll increase the amount of kills needed to escape.

•The gold amount in the main menu can be increased (or decreased) at your leisure now to facilitate play testing in these early stages.

Special thanks to the 16 people that bought the game so far <3

notes.title: Update Notes, July 2nd
notes.notes: Fixed an issue in multiplayer that prevented hosts from continuing after a joined player disconnected.

notes.title: Regular Update #2
notes.notes:
Box Wrangler has been updated to include a new level which has a surprise in store for players who light all 5 special candles. Survive 5 minutes there and check the top left corner of the map.

1 out of 50 Skeletons spawned may now have a minigun.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
[h2]New Weapon[/h2]
Added a new secondary weapon, the axe!

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
The AK-47 and P90 should be stable in multiplayer now.
You can get the bon fire achievement now!

[h2]New Achievement[/h2]
Added a new achievement for burning trees.
